initial.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a clean production concept for a new HeavyMach side-scrolling game enemy sprite, one aircraft only, nose facing LEFT, almost exact orthographic side view with just enough upper wing surface to identify the real aircraft. Transparent background, centered entire aircraft, no text labels outside aircraft, no shadow, no ground, no gear, no flames, no contrails, no missiles in flight.
Reference 1 is ONLY the exact real aircraft shape/proportions. Preserve its actual nose, canopy, main wings, tailplane, intakes and engine exhaust geometry; no shortened/chibi/armored redesign.
Reference 2 is ONLY Lux Lunae 55th Unit livery: dark charcoal olive-grey weathered metal, restrained thin muted gold/yellow stripe along nose and fuselage shoulder, gold leading edge of vertical tail, small gold shield with lunar/rearing-creature motif on vertical tail, white tail number "055", muted cyan glass. No other national insignia. This is a custom application of that livery to the real aircraft shape.
Reference 3 is ONLY existing HeavyMach paint rendering style: hand-painted 2D military metal, restrained worn highlights, readable panel planes, simple crisp dark silhouette with no white halo, no thick comic outline, no noisy decorative dots. Retain real proportions even when matching texture. Full plane should occupy most canvas width with generous but not excessive transparent padding. Make clean recognizable silhouette when reduced to 120 game pixels.
